content: रात्रौ शयनम् A festival on the 11th day of the first half of आषाढ, regarded as the night of the gods, beginning with the summer solstice.

शयनम् [शी-ल्युट्] .²1 Sleeping, sleep, lying down. .²2 A bed, couch; शयनस्थो न भुञ्जीत <ls>Ms. 4. 74</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 95</ls>; <ls>V. 3. 10</ls>. .²3 Copulation, sexual union.  .{@-अ(आ)गारः, -रम्, -गृहम्@} a bed-chamber, sleeping apartments.
